summary:
L0 lib/session.ml:42 — confirmed: expired token accepted after refactor.
L1 lib/retry.ml:88 — refuted: backoff preserved by caller wrapper.

findings.message: The session token expiry check was dropped, so an expired token is accepted as valid.
findings.failure_scenario: A caller passes a token whose expiry has elapsed; validate_session returns true and the request proceeds with a stale identity.
findings.evidence_snippet: let validate_session token = Hashtbl.mem sessions token.id
findings.why_now: This PR removed the `not (expired token)` guard from validate_session, so the new call path no longer rejects expired tokens.
findings.suggested_fix: let validate_session token = Hashtbl.mem sessions token.id && not (expired token)

overall_assessment: One confirmed lead; the retry lead was refuted.
